patches.value: For every real mean-zero g with ||g||_{H^gamma}<=R, there exists a unique C([0,T];dot H^gamma) solution of U_t=U U_x+U_xxx with U(0,x)=-g(-x), with a finite uniform homogeneous norm bound depending only on T,gamma,R. For smooth initial g this solution is spatially smooth. For any two real mean-zero initial data in this class whose initial L2 norms sum to at most B0, their corresponding source-sign flows satisfy sup_{[0,T]}||U-Utilde||_2<=C(T,B0)||U(0)-Utilde(0)||_2.
